correctness.rationale: When whiteness occupies >=2 parts, the induced white graph is connected, and each blue vertex in part i has W-w_i white neighbors; first force exists iff W-w_i=1 in a part with blue vertex. The force leaves one occupied white part and finishes using singleton components, proving iff. For support <=1 forcing is immediate. Support-stratified binomial counting with subtraction of twice-counted two-singleton white sets proves polynomial including singleton parts. Independent componentwise white-graph forcing simulation and polynomial comparison matched 18,828 subsets over 102 small part profiles; the all-size proof is the symbolic first-force argument.
